fields.idNumberPlaceholder: Enter your ID, passport, or asylum number

signup.heroDesc: Create your account, answer the rider application questions, and upload all KYC documents including 3 payslips before you enter the platform.
signup.title: Create account & application
signup.subtitle: No proof of address required. Upload ID, licence, selfie, and 3 latest payslips.
signup.step1HelpTitle: What you need for this step
signup.step1Help: Use your real name, a working email address, a WhatsApp number, your ID / passport / asylum number, and a password with at least 6 characters.
signup.step2Help: Add the address where you stay most of the time so support, verification, and recovery teams can reach the right area.
signup.step3Help: Choose a bike, tell us which delivery platforms you use, and add payout details. If you choose EFT, all banking fields are required.
signup.weeklyFeeDesc: Ready-to-go bikes display their weekly rental amount and registration in the list.
signup.step4Help: Upload all KYC documents now. ID document, driver's licence, and selfie may be PDF or image files. Payslips may be uploaded as PDF or JPG / JPEG. If you upload a JPG / JPEG payslip, you must type the Rand amount for that image manually.
signup.autoDecisionDesc: OnFleet reads the 3 latest payslips, totals the paid amounts, and computes average weekly earnings. Below R1000/week = auto-decline with 2-week retry. R1000/week or more = auto-pre-approval.
signup.payslipHelp: Upload PDF for automatic reading, or JPG / JPEG and type the Rand amount manually.
signup.randAmountHelp: JPEG payslips are saved with the amount you type here.
signup.successToast: Account created and full application submitted. We are reviewing your documents now.
signup.modalDesc: Your application cannot continue until the required information below is completed correctly.

validation.enterPhone: Enter your phone or WhatsApp number.
validation.enterIdNumber: Enter your ID number, passport number, or asylum number.
validation.passwordLength: Your password must be at least 6 characters long.
validation.selectPlatform: Select at least one delivery platform.
validation.enterAccountHolder: Enter the bank account holder name.
validation.uploadSelfie: Upload your selfie holding your ID.
validation.enterPayslipAmount: Enter the Rand amount for Payslip {{n}} because JPEG payslips are captured manually.

fleetApply.availableBikesDesc: Choose from bikes available for rent-to-own through {{fleetName}}. Select your preferred bike during the application.
fleetApply.clickToSelect: Click a bike to pre-select it in your application. You can change your selection in step 3.
fleetApply.title: Submit rider application
fleetApply.bikeAvailabilityDesc: Only bikes available for this fleet owner appear here.
fleetApply.step4Help: Upload ID document, driver's licence, selfie, and your latest 3 payslips. Payslips can be PDF, image, Word document, or any common format — if not a PDF, you'll be asked to type the monthly Rand amount shown on it.
fleetApply.autoDecisionDesc: Three payslips are required to calculate average weekly earnings. Below R1000/week auto-declines. R1000/week or above moves the application into review.
fleetApply.errCouldNotOpen: Could not open rider application link
fleetApply.errCompletePersonal: Please complete all required personal details
fleetApply.errSelectPlatform: Select at least one delivery platform
fleetApply.errEftDetails: Please complete all EFT banking details
fleetApply.errUploadAll: Please upload ID document, licence, selfie, and 3 payslips
fleetApply.errPayslipAmount: Enter the monthly Rand amount shown on payslip {{n}} (non-PDF file)
fleetApply.successToast: Application submitted successfully. The fleet owner will review your details.
